summary: Iteration 4 tested auto-scroll + details panel features. Auto-scroll works correctly for individual chat, group chat, and after sending messages. DetailsPanel renders correctly with all required info. CRITICAL BUG FOUND: DetailsPanel cannot be opened by real users — CometChat's internal components call stopPropagation(), preventing clicks from bubbling up to the .chat-header-clickable wrapper div. Only programmatic dispatch_event() triggers it.

ui_bugs.issue: CRITICAL: Real users CANNOT open the details panel by clicking the chat header. CometChat's CometChatMessageHeader component internally calls stopPropagation() on click events, preventing bubbling to the parent .chat-header-clickable div's React onClick handler. Only dispatch_event() on the div itself (not via coordinate-based clicking) triggers it.
ui_bugs.rca: React onClick on .chat-header-clickable relies on event bubbling from CometChatMessageHeader children. CometChat stops propagation internally. Fix: use native DOM addEventListener with {capture: true} via useRef+useEffect instead of React onClick on the wrapper div.
ui_bugs.fix_suggestion: Replace onClick={handleOpenDetails} on the div with a useRef + useEffect that calls headerRef.current.addEventListener('click', handleOpenDetails, true) using capture phase. This fires BEFORE stopPropagation can block it.

action_items: CRITICAL: Fix .chat-header-clickable onClick to use capture-phase native listener instead of React onClick. Current React onClick relies on event bubbling which CometChat stops. Fix: const clickableRef = useRef(); useEffect(() => { const el = clickableRef.current; if (!el) return; el.addEventListener('click', handleOpenDetails, true); return () => el.removeEventListener('click', handleOpenDetails, true); }, [handleOpenDetails]); — and change div to use ref={clickableRef} instead of onClick={handleOpenDetails}. Apply same fix to both renderChats() and renderGroups() header clickable divs.

details_panel_click_not_working.root_cause: The .chat-header-clickable div wraps CometChatMessageHeader. When a user clicks anywhere in the header area, the click event first hits an element inside CometChatMessageHeader (e.g., cometchat-list-item__body-title). CometChat calls event.stopPropagation() internally, preventing the React synthetic event from bubbling up to the .chat-header-clickable parent. The React onClick={handleOpenDetails} on the wrapper is never invoked.
details_panel_click_not_working.reproduction: Login → open any chat → click on the contact name/avatar area in the header → observe details panel does NOT open.
details_panel_click_not_working.mitigation: Use capture-phase event listener: headerRef.current.addEventListener('click', handleOpenDetails, true). Capture phase fires top-down BEFORE stopPropagation in the bubbling phase, so CometChat cannot block it.
details_panel_click_not_working.severity: CRITICAL — Feature completely broken for real users
